class.name: ScriptTestExecutionResult
class.brief_description: Structured outcome of a guarded [ScriptTestExecution] call.
class.description: Returned when a guarded call finishes, times out, aborts, or fails with a script runtime error. Pass/fail policy is left to the runner; [constant STATUS_COMPLETED] only means the guarded method returned without guard interruption. Diagnostic events are not recorded here; compose diagnostic capture separately when needed.

members.member: Wall time spent in the guarded call.
Abort, timeout, or runtime-error text. Empty for [constant STATUS_COMPLETED].
Return value from the guarded method. Meaningful only for [constant STATUS_COMPLETED].
Completion status for the guarded call.
Echo of the guard's configured timeout.

constants.constant: The guarded method finished without guard interruption.
The guard deadline expired at a checkpoint or await boundary.
The guard was aborted cooperatively or by an opted-in fatal diagnostic.
The guarded method failed with an ordinary script runtime error.
